editorial:
You're dropped into a city on the edge of collapse, where a pandemic has turned ordinary people into something terrifying. The story follows a young couple, Jim and Kat, who are separated when the outbreak hits and spend the film fighting through streets full of violence to find each other. The vibe is relentless and grim, with almost no breaks from the chaos. If you like horror that pushes boundaries, this one grabs you fast and never lets go, pulling you into a nightmare that feels way too close to home.

The acting feels raw and believable, and the pacing rarely slows down, which keeps the tension high from start to finish. The downside is that the gore is extreme and the tone can feel exhausting, so it is not for everyone. Fans of intense, no-holds-barred horror will get the most out of it.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Jim finally reaches Kat, but she has already been infected and turns on him. He is forced to fight the person he loves most, and the film ends with him alone and broken, surrounded by a city still drowning in chaos. The twist is that their reunion, the goal of the whole movie, becomes the moment everything falls apart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves extreme horror and survival thrillers.
